claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 faithfully captures the introductory mandate of 40 CFR 262.11 requiring a person generating solid waste (defined in 40 CFR 261.2) to make an accurate hazardous waste determination to ensure proper management under RCRA regulations. All dimensions are properly aligned with the source.

Claim C0001 reproduces the requirement in paragraph (a) regarding timing and conditions for making the hazardous waste determination: at the point of waste generation before alteration, and at any time during management if properties may have changed. The passive construction and scope accurately reflect the source.

Claim C0002 accurately extracts paragraph (b), requiring a determination of whether the solid waste is excluded under 40 CFR 261.4. The actor, modality, and reference to 261.4 are correct and supported.

Claim C0003 correctly conveys the requirement in the first sentence of paragraph (c) to use knowledge of the waste to determine if it meets listing descriptions under subpart D of 40 CFR part 261, conditionally upon the waste not being excluded under 40 CFR 261.4.

Claim C0004 preserves the descriptive statement from paragraph (c) identifying acceptable knowledge components (origin, composition, process, feedstock, and other reliable information). Modality 'possible' correctly reflects descriptive 'may include', and the list alternatives are preserved in the summary.

In § 262.11(c), the permission to file a delisting petition under 40 CFR 260.20 and 260.22 is governed by the paragraph lead-in condition ('If the waste is not excluded under 40 CFR 261.4') and section lead-in actor context ('A person who generates a solid waste'). Claim C0005 extracts only the later permission sentence and restricts its scope to 'If the waste is listed', omitting the essential prerequisite that the waste is not already excluded under 261.4 as well as the generator qualification. This broadens the permission to admit cases the source excludes (such as filing a delisting petition for waste already excluded under 261.4 or by a non-generator). Thus, scope and summary are errors.

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0000 is fully covered by claim C0000, which accurately captures the general duty of a solid waste generator to make an accurate hazardous waste determination.
Unit U0001 is covered by claim C0001, which includes the requirement that the determination be made at the point of generation before dilution, mixing, or alteration.
Unit U0002 is covered by claim C0001, which includes the requirement that the determination be made at any time during management when properties have changed or may change.
Unit U0003 is covered by claim C0002, capturing the requirement to determine if the waste is excluded under 40 CFR 261.4.
Unit U0004 is covered by claim C0003, which preserves the prerequisite that the waste is not excluded under 261.4 and the duty to evaluate listing descriptions under subpart D of part 261.
Unit U0005 is covered by claim C0004, which retains all listed elements of acceptable knowledge under paragraph (c).

Unit U0006 is only partially covered by claim C0005 because C0005 omits the governing prerequisite that the waste must not be excluded under 40 CFR 261.4 as well as the governing applicant context from § 262.11, resulting in an overbroad permission.
